_why: Single source of truth for the Robolectric android-all runtime cache. Robolectric downloads these jars while the tests run, outside Gradle's and setup-gradle's caches, so a cold runner is the only place the download can flake. scripts/check_ci_preflight.py and app/src/test/java/com/aistudio/alphapulse/build/RobolectricRuntimeCacheBddSpec.kt both read this file: the workflow key, the prefetched artifacts and every SDK the suite pins with @Config must agree, so adding an SDK or bumping the version without a new key fails cheaply instead of reintroducing the download.
